[[File:Jan Westergard 2008 US East Nationals champion with banner.jpg|thumb|right|260px|[[Jan Westergard]] with the first-place trophy.]]
'''2008 US East Nationals''' was a Players Committee constructed event held on 28 June 2008 at the Origins Game Fair, Greater Columbus Convention Center, Columbus, Ohio, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS15]]).<ref name="pc-sid83">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072011/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=83 East Nationals! Official Tournament Announcement.] (10 April 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 12 July 2008.</ref><ref name="pc-sid87">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=87 &#91;East Nationals&#93; Origins Gaming Convention, June 27th and June 28th] (25 June 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 12 July 2008.</ref> [[Jan Westergard]] won, defeating [[Justin Desai]] in the final.<ref name="pc-sid88">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803131916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=88 2008 East Nationals Champ - Jan Westergard] (1 July 2008), swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 August 2008.</ref> The event chairperson was [[Brad Eier]].<ref name="pc-sid83" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
* '''Site:''' Origins Game Fair, Greater Columbus Convention Center, 400 North High Street, Columbus, Ohio<ref name="pc-sid83" />
* '''Dates:''' 28 June 2008 (the convention ran 25–29 June; warm-up and side events on the Friday)<ref name="pc-sid87" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Jan Westergard]]<ref name="pc-sid88" />

== Results ==

No standings or decklists were published. The Players Committee named the finalists; the top 4 match comes from the photographer's caption.<ref name="flickr">[https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/ brad227lex], flickr (11 photos, posted 1 July 2008).</ref>

{| class="wikitable"
! Place !! Player !! Notes
|-
| 1 || [[Jan Westergard]] || Final game 2: "Westergard's combat racing vs Desai's Hunt Down"<ref name="flickr" />
|-
| 2 || [[Justin Desai]] || Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi in the final<ref name="flickr" />
|-
| 3–4 || Hollingworth (first name not given) || Lost to Desai in the top 4<ref name="flickr" />
|}

== Side events ==

The announcement promised two limited events for players without cards, a Cube draft and a sealed-pack booster draft.<ref name="pc-sid83" /> A [[Reflections III]] sealed-deck event ran while the top cut was being played.<ref name="flickr" />
